read.thesis: Record Q3 adjusted EPS of $2.85 (+22%) on $720M VII; core earnings also grew, with direct expense ratio 11.9% tracking below the 12.1% target, but beat was helped by private equity marks.

triggers.label: VII $720M vs ~$400M implied guide
triggers.quote: At $720 million in the third quarter, VII was well above our implied quarterly guidance of $400 million.

triggers.label: Expense ratio 11.9% vs 12.1% target
triggers.quote: Our direct expense ratio was 11.9%, on track to beat our 12.1% full year target.

triggers.label: PRT volume lighter, called timing
triggers.quote: While U.S. pension risk transfers activity has been lighter this year, we see this as timing, not a structural change.

triggers.label: Q4 VII assumed back to $400M
triggers.quote: we're assuming we get back to the normal $400 million run rate.

guidance.quote: Year-to-date VII is approximately $1.5 billion, putting us on course to exceed our full year guidance of approximately $1.6 billion.
Our direct expense ratio was 11.9%, on track to beat our 12.1% full year target.
we expect full year RIS adjusted earnings to finish slightly north of the midpoint of our $1.6 billion to $1.8 billion outlook range.
We remain on track for full year adjusted earnings within our $240 million to $280 million target range.
For the time being, we are sticking with the 11.3% ratio that we talked about at Investor Day.
we still feel comfortable with our 65% to 75% range that we provided.
modestly below our 2026 guidance range of 24% to 26%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: putting us on course to exceed our full year guidance of approximately $1.6 billion.
Our direct expense ratio was 11.9%, on track to beat our 12.1% full year target.
The group life mortality ratio was 79.5%, well below our target range.
In non-medical health, the interest-adjusted benefit ratio was 72.3%, within our 70% to 75% target range.
We remain on track for full year adjusted earnings within our $240 million to $280 million target range.

red_flags.label: Beat driven by PE/VC marks (VII $720M vs $400M guide)
red_flags.quote: At $720 million in the third quarter, VII was well above our implied quarterly guidance of $400 million.

red_flags.label: Disability claims and mental/nervous claims rising
red_flags.quote: we did see an increase in mental and nervous claims over the course of the year.

red_flags.label: Stock-comp expense drag 1-2 pts on expense ratio
red_flags.quote: it was probably maybe 1 point or 2 on the expense ratio

evasions.quote: we always said and we still see this to be a competitive but rationally priced industry.
We do have a back-ended pipeline this year.
